title: {Syn} AlphaDev Looked for Faster Sorting and Hashing Code
content:
AlphaDev used reinforcement learning to discover low-level algorithms, including improved short sorting routines that were later added to widely used C++ library implementations.

It is an example of AI contributing not only predictions, but small executable improvements in software infrastructure.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
